content:
Elaine: Quick async — finalizing the chat/completions contract for streaming + tool calls. Two small asks: 1) legacy clients sometimes send message.role=null or omit role entirely — confirm intended server behavior (treat as 'user' or reject?). 2) ordering semantics for stream events related to tool calls (start/arg/chunk/complete). I'll paste a tiny sketch below.

Maya: for (1) I think we decided to treat missing/null role as 'user' for backward compat w/ mobile. but we should call it out explicitly in the spec.

Linh: agreed w/ Maya. rejecting would break a bunch of older SDKs. default to 'user' + log a lint warning in the SDK.

AJ: for (2) can you show the sketch? curious about interleaving with deltas.

Elaine: sketch: ```json
{
  "stream": [
    {"event": "msg", "role": null, "content": "hi"},
    {"event": "tool_call_start", "tool": "search", "id": "t1"},
    {"event": "tool_arg", "id": "t1", "arg": "q=redwood"},
    {"event": "tool_chunk", "id": "t1", "chunk": "..."},
    {"event": "tool_complete", "id": "t1", "result": "..."},
    {"event": "msg_delta", "role": "assistant", "content_delta": "found results"}
  ]
}
```

Pat: okay, ordering: tool_call_start -> zero or more (tool_arg|tool_chunk) -> tool_complete. msg_delta from assistant may come before or after tool_complete depending on runtime buffering, but we should guarantee per-tool event ordering by id.

Maya: +1 on per-tool id ordering. Also propose adding an explicit finalization event for tool args: tool_args_complete. that makes it easier for consumers to know arg set is finished without relying on timeouts.

AJ: I worry about extra events bloating payloads, but tool_args_complete seems reasonable if we can emit it deterministically. otherwise consumers need to handle late args arriving.

Linh: impl note — runtime currently batches arg fragments into tool_chunk. adding an args_complete flag on tool_complete could be an alternative. less new events.

Elaine: options captured. quick decision needed: default role behavior = 'user' (backcompat) + emit lint/warning. ordering: guarantee per-tool id ordering; prefer args_complete flag on tool_complete (fewer new event types). who can turn this into a tiny PR to the spec and add SDK lint change?

AJ: I can open the PR for the spec (short). will include example and mention nullable role handling.

Pat: I can do the SDK lint change in the TS SDK. will add a warning when role is null/undefined and opt-in strict parsing toggle.

Maya: can someone add a short note for runtime folks about buffered msg_delta timing? just say it may arrive after tool_complete due to KV flush.

Linh: I'll ping runtime owners in #eng-runtime after this thread.

schema-bot: spec-verify: note — previous schema tests expect non-null role. update unit-tests if we accept null->'user'.

Elaine: thanks all. AJ please tag the PR with "contract:streaming-toolcall" and assign to me. Pat assign a follow-up ticket for SDK warning + opt-in strict mode. I'll write the runtime note and post in eng-runtime. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks — small follow-ups but good to lock down now.

AJ: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/specs/pull/214 — draft includes samples and the args flag option. assigning to @Elaine.

Pat: created SDK issue: https://git.internal/redwood/ts-sdk/issues/842 — describes lint + strict parse toggle.

Elaine: perfect. closing the loop here. we'll sync if anyone hits edgecases.

Linh: pinged runtime owners in #eng-runtime, left note about msg_delta timing and KV flush.

Maya: end.
